evidence.title: BG.IBELICK - Modern, Ready-to-Use Background Snippets for Developers

name: BG.IBELICK
summary: Copy-paste full-page background snippets for developers, crafted with Tailwind CSS and vanilla CSS.
description: Collection of ready-to-use background snippets you paste into a project, each made for a full-page background and crafted with Tailwind CSS and vanilla CSS. Every snippet has a live preview and copy-code button on the site, and new snippets are added over time.
contains: crafted with Tailwind CSS and vanilla CSS
live preview and copy-code buttons in the browser
new snippets announced on the site
